axes.tableAxis: 十干 — one table per 干, in the served order 甲乙丙丁戊己庚辛壬癸 (each table text contains essentially only its own 干; see per-table ganCountInTable / otherGanCharsPresent)
axes.rowAxis: the site stream gives 25 rows per table with no column axis; within those 25 rows the short rows carry a 支 plus the table 干 (e.g. 申癸 / 酉癸 / 戌癸 …) and one row carries the divider 「六<干>日」. Row roles are an INFERENCE from the served text, not an explicit field of the source.
axes.zhiLabelsObserved: the 支 labels appear in the site stream in the order 申 酉 戌 亥 未 午 | 六<干>日 | 子 丑 巳 辰 卯 寅 — this order is reproduced identically in all 10 tables
axes.residueOwnHeaders: the flattened electronic text still preserves the printed table's own column-label fragments, e.g. 甲巳/甲午/甲未/甲申 and 甲寅/甲丑/甲子/甲亥 (see the residue lines quoted in the cross-check)

residueCrossCheck.selection: review==draft AND (残格 or 总钤 present in the entry JSON)
method: 1. residue text = fulltext.md line addressed by the entry paragraphId (daliuren-daquan:L<line>-L<line>)
2. comparison form = that line with ALL whitespace removed, then the documented variant unification applied
3. the residue line is assigned to a 干 SECTION from the flattened text itself: the ten surviving 4-column header lines (recorded in residueSectionStarts) run 甲乙丙丁戊己庚辛壬癸 in order

4. candidates are restricted to that section's own 干-table. Without this restriction short 支 triples produce spurious "unique" hits in a foreign 干-table (e.g. a 癸-section line matching 甲表 r3), so the unrestricted numbers are also recorded below for transparency
5. CELL_* = comparison form occurs contiguously inside a served row-cell; ROW_* = not contiguous but the character multiset is contained in one served row-cell
6. UNIQUE = exactly one candidate row in the section's own table; AMBIGUOUS = 2+ candidates; WRONG_TABLE_ONLY / UNMATCHED = no candidate in the own table / nowhere
matching is order-independent for ROW_* and is NOT an assertion that the residue occupies a particular printed column: the source preserves no column axis.
